name: Srisawad Corporation Public Company Limited
summary: Srisawad Corporation Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides financial services in Thailand and internationally. It operates through Hire Purchase; Loan; and Asset Management segment. The company provides loan granting, non-performing assets management, PICO finance loan, and credit sales services; and management and consulting services for retail credit systems. It also offers loan and debt collection; digital loan platform; and secured loans.
